8.6.5.7. iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.pathgen.DirObj2NodePaths.isBentLeg¶

DirObj2NodePaths.isBentLeg(processedNodeIndex)¶

An utility function that determines if processedNodeIndex connects to a bent leg of a switch.

Parameters:processedNodeIndex (NodeIndex) – The node index to be determined if it connects to the bent leng of a switch.
Return type:bool
Returns:Return True if processedNodeIndex connects to a bent leg of a switch.
